attribution.localizedCause: Q18 compare_forward already requires exactly 64 manifest records for each of 244 unique labels; the wrapper incorrectly required the raw manifest record count to equal the grouped comparison count.

decision.rationale: Finalize the retained exact measurements by deriving fixtureComplete from the sequential comparator postcondition and 244-group population; preserve all scientific artifacts and reevaluate every frozen predicate.

hypothesis.rationale: The retained measurements strongly indicate exact forward parity, but the frozen promotion decision used an incorrectly implemented completeness measurement and cannot support the hypothesis until corrected and revalidated.

retiredDimensions: Do not compare raw sequential fixture record count directly with grouped tensor-comparison count.
transferableLessons: Completeness predicates must use the comparator population unit: sequential per-position fixture records and grouped output tensors are different cardinalities even when coverage is complete.
uncertainties: A receipt-bound finalizer must verify that the promoted sequential comparator completed, returned all 244 groups, and was bound in the parent source closure before setting fixtureComplete.

reasons: The process and result were schema-valid and every substantive tensor, branch, replay, dependency, guard, and source measurement passed, but fixtureComplete compared 15616 per-position manifest records with 244 sequentially grouped comparison records and therefore reported false.
